articles.title: Rubio warned Trump of Nvidia CEO's affair with Chinese 'spy'. Did he ignore it?
articles.description: US President Donald Trump expressed confidence in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding allegations of ties to a Chinese spy. Trump stated he believes Huang was unaware of the alleged spy's identity during an FBI investigation. Rubio's memo on Huang's relationships surfaced before Trump's visit to Beijing, indicating prior knowledge of the situation. The FBI is scrutinizing the implications on national security concerning Nvidia's technology and partnerships.

articles.title: 'Injured throat with scissors': Kolkata techie's girlfriend 'can't remember' argument
articles.description: Sarthak Sarkar, a software engineer, was found murdered in his rental flat in Kolkata after a domestic dispute. His live-in partner, Sanchalika Basu, and her mother, Moumita Basu, have been arrested in connection with the case. Investigators are examining conflicting statements provided by the arrested women regarding the circumstances of Sarkar's death. The couple reportedly argued over allegations of extramarital affairs shortly before the incident occurred.

articles.title: 'I'd quake in my seat': Sonia recalls Indira's temper, early days as bride in memoir
articles.description: Sonia Gandhi’s memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, offers an intimate account of Indira Gandhi’s temper, recalling how staff were made to stand in corners, a senior Congress leader ordered to face a wall and others ignored for days. Sonia also describes Rajiv’s reassurance during her mother-in-law’s outbursts, Indira’s domestic routines, love for sarees and photographs, and how grandchildren gradually softened her temperament.

articles.title: 'Warrants urgent attention': SC flags vehicle pollution in Delhi-NCR, seeks action plan
articles.description: The Supreme Court has mandated that Delhi and three adjacent states intensify measures to combat vehicle emissions. Officials are tasked with reporting on the implementation of laws governing aging and non-compliant vehicles. With rising pollution levels in the National Capital Region, the court emphasized the need for inter-state collaboration on vehicle management and stricter adherence to emission standards. The matter will be reviewed again on November 23.

Over 2,000 teachers, students face political persecution in Bangladesh: Report
articles.description: Since August 2024, over 2,000 students and teachers have reportedly faced politically motivated persecution across Bangladesh. The persecution includes academic exclusion, physical attacks, and criminal proceedings targeting individuals linked to the Bangladesh Awami League. Numerous teachers have experienced exclusion from professional activities, physical assaults, and legal issues. JusticeMakers Bangladesh has called for independent investigations into these reported abuses.

articles.title: Russia's last major independent newspaper Novaya Gazeta shuts down after 33 years
articles.description: Novaya Gazeta, an independent newspaper critical of the Kremlin, has shut down its Moscow office after three decades. The closure came as a result of mounting government pressure and sustained restrictions on independent media. Journalists mourned the loss of their office while recalling the legacy of their investigative work. Some staff members have relocated abroad and continue reporting under a new publication called Novaya Gazeta Europe.

articles.title: China hits $1 trillion trade surplus milestone for second year in a row
articles.description: China's trade surplus surpassed $1 trillion in the first ten months, driven primarily by high-tech product demand. Exports increased significantly due to the global AI investment boom, although imports also grew faster than expected. Domestic consumption remains weak, which has pressured manufacturers to seek overseas markets for growth. Trade tensions with the European Union and the United States add complexity to China's export situation.

articles.title: Odisha Civil Services exam: Cabinet approves unlimited attempts for all categories, removes cap on OPSC recruitment test
articles.description: The Odisha Cabinet has approved an amendment to the Odisha Civil Services (Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination) Rules, 1991, removing the limit on the number of attempts for the OPSC Civil Services examination across all categories. Candidates can now appear for the examination unlimited times, subject to the prescribed upper age limit and other eligibility criteria.

articles.title: IOAA-Jr 2026: From Puducherry to Maharashtra, meet the 5 Indian students who won medals at the International Astronomy Olympiad
articles.description: Indian students have won five medals, including two gold, two silver and one bronze, at the 5th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics for Juniors (IOAA-Jr) 2026 in Thailand. Competing against participants from 25 countries, the five-member contingent delivered an impressive performance. The winners represented Puducherry, Gujarat, Rajasthan and Maharashtra. Organised between November 1 and 8, the competition brought together 104 students from across the world.
